Survey koḷanda/koḷandɛ/kuLantai child preserve the southern infant formation, with source lateral and capitalization unchanged. proposals.evidence: DEDR2896 attests Tamil/Malayalam cōḷam, Kannada/Kodagu/Tulu jōḷa, Telugu/Gondi jonna/jona and Gadaba jonnēl for great millet/jowar/maize. Survey forms retain the southern lateral versus central nasal branches, with Muthuvan -kam/-ku expansion. The source generic millet gloss is preserved; DEDR’s comparison with similar IA words (CDIAL10434) remains an origin/contact caveat, not an asserted loan route. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
